# Burning Springs: Spawn Map RAD Boar / RAD Scorpions / Deathclaws / Ogua & Rust Raider

![Burning Springs: Spawn Map RAD Boar / RAD Scorpions / Deathclaws / Ogua & Rust Raider](/uploads/608_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

There are some new enemies in the new area of Burning Springs. These opponents are also often part of **daily or weekly challenges**. Accordingly, you will look for them a little more often on certain days. Therefore, you can now use this map, which shows the spawn points of the opponents in question. If there is no **spawn chance**, it is 100%.

### Burning Springs map with the following opponents:

- RAD boar
- Burning RAD scorpions
- Armored Deathclaws
- Burning Ogua
- Rust Raider

For a better overview, the names of the places are not shown on the map. If you don't know any places yet, feel free to look at a map with the place names in the related posts (under the comments).

*As always, click on the map to view in higher resolution.*

![Burning Springs Enemy Spawn Map (RAD Boar, Burning RAD Scorpions, Armored Deathclaws, Burning Ogua & Rust Raider](/uploads/nukaknights-post-burning-springs-enemies-map.jpg)
